- 12m: Launch demo + fallback plan
- 6m: Policy update: default data retention change
- 10m: Roadmap highlights + live Q&A

Maya (CEO): Slides + preread: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1rw-allhands-feb (view comments)
Jamal (VP Product): Demo will show Hosted -> Dedicated fallback and canary rollout flags. Adding sample prompts to slides.
Leila (Engineering Manager): Can we add a 1-slide smoke test checklist after the demo? I'll prep it.
Kendall (Head Eng): Infra on standby for burst tuning during demo. Tag #eng-runtime if you see issues.
Ivy (People Ops): RSVP if attending in-office lunch: tinyurl.com/rw-allhands-lunch
Ops-bot: Calendar invite sent, reminder 30m before. Recording + captions enabled.
Maya (CEO): Policy note: internal dev orgs default retention -> 90 days; enterprise customers per contract. Security/legal approved; comms next week.
Jamal (VP Product): Runbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-runbook-wip  comments welcome.
Leila (Engineering Manager): I'll add owners for post-launch smoke tests and rollback steps.
Maya (CEO): If you want a prioritized question answered, put it in the form: https://forms.gle/rw-allhands-qa
Maya (CEO): We'll post recording + a TL;DR in the company wiki after. If you want your question anonymized in the digest reply "anon". Closing thread in 72h with final actions. :sparkles:
